name: Waymo Open Dataset — End-to-End Driving Dataset
description: Large-scale benchmark dataset designed for end-to-end autonomous driving planners that predict future vehicle trajectories directly from 8 surround camera streams providing 360-degree coverage, high-level navigation routing instructions, and past ego kinematics across 5,000 20-second driving segments in diverse urban conditions.

license.name: Waymo Open Dataset Terms of Service (Non-Commercial Research)

source_references.title: Waymo Open Dataset Portal
source_references.notes: Official Waymo Open Dataset platform announcing the End-to-End driving benchmark and long-tail evaluation challenges.

source_references.title: WOD-E2E: Waymo Open Dataset for End-to-End Driving in Challenging Long-tail Scenarios
source_references.notes: Foundational publication by Xu et al. establishing the WOD-E2E benchmark, rare event mining pipeline, surround-camera setup, and expert preference (RFS) reward annotations.

verification.notes: Verified against Waymo Open Dataset portal and arXiv publication (DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2510.26125).

size.notes: Aggregate byte size is not formally published on the official Waymo Open Dataset portal; payload comprises 8 surround-view camera video streams, ego kinematics, and text routing instructions across 5,000 20-second segments.

citation.paper_title: WOD-E2E: Waymo Open Dataset for End-to-End Driving in Challenging Long-tail Scenarios

provenance.collection_method: Captured across diverse urban environments and conditions by the Waymo vehicle fleet, providing 5,000 20-second segments collected at 10 Hz with 8 surrounding cameras, vehicle kinematics, and text-based routing instructions.
provenance.curation_notes: Officially released in March 2025 as part of the Waymo Open Dataset family. Comprises 5,000 20-second driving segments with 360-degree 8-camera surround vision, past 4-second trajectories (at 4Hz), ego velocity and acceleration, text routing instructions, and (for training) future 5-second trajectory planning ground truth.
